resources.convention: Test the UI the way a user sees it. Query elements by role and label first (`getByRole`, `getByLabelText`, `getByText`); `data-testid` is the last resort. Assert what is visible and what happens (adding an item makes that item appear), not internal state or render counts. Mock little: mock at the network boundary (`fetch` or MSW), not child components or the project's own hooks. Many component and screen-level integration tests, few end-to-end tests and only for the important journeys. Give each test three steps, arrange, act, assert; name a test after the behaviour.

Tests are deterministic, never flaky. No `sleep` or fixed waits: wait on a condition (`findBy...`, `waitFor`). Each test builds and cleans up its own state (reset mocks, timers, local storage) and does not depend on order. Sample data does not depend on the clock or on randomness. The network is always mocked with deterministic responses, error paths included (404, 400, network failure). A test that passes only when rerun is a bug in the test: fix the cause, do not add a retry.
